news.title: Christmas break
news.body:
The last event of the year takes place on Thursday 17th December, with The Hereford Academy closing for a 2-week break over Christmas & New Year.

The fixtures have been scheduled to reflect this break in the season, so the key dates for each league are confirmed as follows:

**Monday League**
- Last Super 6's event of 2026: Monday 14th December
- First Super 6's event of 2027: Monday 4th January

**Thursday League**
- Last Super 6's event of 2026: Thursday 17th December
- First Super 6's event of 2027: Thursday 7th January

We would like to take this opportunity to thank you for your ongoing support, and to wish all of our players and staff a merry Christmas, and a happy and healthy New Year!

news.title: Welcome to the new Super 6's website
news.body:
Tables, fixtures and results for both leagues now update automatically after each league night, with form, charts and a page for every team.

Find your team from the League page, and tap Follow on your team's page to see your next game on the home page.

news.title: FA Referee Course: January 2027
news.body:
Herefordshire FA's next FA Referee Course runs on Thursday 14 January (6.30pm – 9.30pm), Sunday 17 January (10am – 6pm) and Thursday 25 March 2027 (7pm – 9pm) at the SSAFA County Ground, Widemarsh Common, Hereford.

Open to anyone aged 14 and over. £145 per person. To book, email Jack at referees@herefordshirefa.com.

news.title: Adult futsal on Wednesday nights
news.body:
Fast, indoor drop-in football all year round, never cancelled for the weather. Wednesdays, 6.30pm – 7.30pm at St Mary's High School, HR1 4DR.

Email Kyle Williams at Kyle.Williams@herefordshirefa.com to join.

news.title: Daytime walking football for over-50s
news.body:
Football without the running. Thursdays, 11am – 12pm at Herefordshire FA, Widemarsh Common, with refreshments until 1pm. £5.

Contact Scott Russell at Scott.Russell@herefordshirefa.com.

news.title: Drop In & Play: new time, same place
news.body: Sunday drop-in football at The Herefordshire FA 3G pitch now runs from 7pm to 8pm. £4, no team needed.

news.title: Christmas HAF Camp
news.body:
Football, arts and crafts and fun activities for 5 to 10 year olds, run by our FA-qualified coaches, in partnership with Herefordshire Council.

Monday 21 and Tuesday 22 December 2026, 10am – 3pm, at the SSAFA County Ground, Widemarsh Common, Hereford, HR4 9NA.

Healthy meals provided, with all dietary requirements catered for. Free for children who receive benefit-related free school meals.

safeguarding.title: Safeguarding
safeguarding.intro: Players aged 16 and 17 can play in our leagues. Everyone involved shares the job of keeping them safe, under The FA's Safeguarding Policy and Procedures.

points: You have the right to enjoy football in a safe, friendly environment.
If anything worries you, on or off the pitch, talk to someone you trust or contact the Designated Safeguarding Officer below.
Find out more about your rights in football from The FA.

links.label: Understanding your rights in football (The FA)

teams.h: If your team has 16 or 17 year old players
teams.intro: Captains and team managers are responsible for the safeguards around their team. The FA asks you to:
steps: Know which of your players are 16 or 17.
Know who manages or coaches the team, including any assistants.
Make sure anyone aged 16 or over who has an unsupervised role with under-18s has an FA DBS check. One check covers all your roles in grassroots football.
Follow The FA's Safeguarding Children Policy.
Give your 16 and 17 year old players safeguarding information.
Ask your team officials to complete The FA's free Safeguarding For All online course.

links.label: DBS checks and safer recruitment (The FA)

contact.h: Report a concern or ask for advice
contact.text: Contact Herefordshire FA's Designated Safeguarding Officer.

wellbeing.intro: Football is good for your head as well as your legs. If things are getting on top of you, it's okay to talk. These services are free and confidential.
wellbeing.emergency: If you or someone else is in danger right now, call 999 or go to A&E.

venue.name: The Hereford Church of England Academy

rules.t: The speed limit on The Academy site is 10mph.
No dogs are allowed on site, except assistance dogs.
Smoking and vaping are strictly prohibited on site.

footwear.intro: Guidance from The Hereford Academy for everyone playing on the 3G pitch. Captains: please pass this on to your players before your first fixture.

ok.t: Recommended. Round moulds are best; triangular, oblong or shaped moulds are also fine.
Recommended and fine to play in.

lastResort.t: Allowed only as a last resort if you have no suitable boots. Not a long-term option for regular players: get moulded studs.

no.t: Not allowed, including chevron-style angled blades (such as some Nike Mercurials), even on hybrid boots with round moulds.
